grammar_focus: be used to do sth(被用来做)/ used to do(过去常常)/ be used to doing(习惯于)三者的区别、a lot of / a great many(可数)/ a great deal of(不可数)、on/in 的固定搭配(on fire / on foot / on purpose / in tears / in a hurry)、have sth done(请人把某事做好)、its 与 it's、too 与 very、win 与 beat(原创承载 NCE3 L25 考点·无需净化·19世纪名帆船卡蒂萨克号 1872 年从上海到英国的运茶竞赛,因风暴折舵与对手擦肩而过)
scene: 卡蒂萨克号是19世纪最著名的帆船之一,如今仍陈列在英国格林威治,停在干船坞上,每年吸引成千上万游客,是往昔巨帆时代一个令人肃然起敬的见证。在蒸汽船取代帆船之前,卡蒂萨克号这样的大帆船曾被用来从中国运茶、从澳大利亚运羊毛。它是有史以来最快的帆船之一,唯一能与之匹敌的是塞莫皮莱号。1872年6月,两船从上海启航,展开一场激动人心的返英竞赛。这场比赛整整持续了四个月,也是同类竞赛的最后一次——它标志着巨帆时代的终结、新纪元的开端。赛程中,塞莫皮莱号最先抵达爪哇,可到了印度洋,卡蒂萨克号反超领先。眼看它就要第一个到家,途中却接连倒霉:八月里一场猛烈风暴把它的舵撕走了,船身左右摇晃,无法掌舵。船员用备用木板在船上临时做了一个舵,费尽力气才装上;这大大拖慢了船速,因为一旦跑得太快,临时舵也会被扯掉。过赤道后,船长在一个港口停靠,请人换了新舵,可这时塞莫皮莱号已领先五百多英里。卡蒂萨克号仅比对手晚一周抵达英国——考虑到途中那么多耽搁,已属难得。毫无疑问,要不是折了舵,它本可轻松赢下这场比赛。

grammar_card.title: used to 三种 / a great deal of / on·in 搭配 / have sth done
grammar_card.intro: ①三个容易混:be used to do sth = 被用来做某事(被动,were used to carry tea);used to do = 过去常常(过去的习惯);be used to doing = 习惯于做。②数量词:a lot of 通用;a great many + 可数名词(a great many ships);a great deal of + 不可数名词(a great deal of luck)。③on/in 的固定搭配:on fire(着火)、on foot(步行)、on purpose(故意)、in tears(流泪)、in a hurry(匆忙)。④have sth done = 请/让别人把某事做好(have a rudder fitted)。⑤its(它的)≠ it's(it is);too(太…以致不好)≠ very;win a race / beat sb。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What piece of bad luck prevented the Cutty Sark from winning the race?
options: A storm tore away her rudder

passage: One of the most famous sailing ships of the 1800s, the Cutty Sark, can still be seen today in Greenwich, England. She sits on dry land, and thousands of visitors come to see her every year. She stands as an impressive reminder of the great ships of the past. Before steamships took over, sailing vessels like the Cutty Sark were used to carry tea from China and wool from Australia. The Cutty Sark was one of the fastest sailing ships ever built, and the only vessel that could match her was the Thermopylae. In June 1872, both ships set off from Shanghai in an exciting race back to England. The race lasted exactly four months and turned out to be the last of its kind, for it marked the end of the age of sail and the start of a new era. The Thermopylae reached Java first, but out on the Indian Ocean the Cutty Sark took the lead. It seemed certain that she would be the first ship home. During the race, however, she had a great deal of bad luck. In August a fierce storm tore away her rudder, and without it the ship rolled from side to side and could not be steered. The crew built a temporary rudder on board from spare planks and fitted it with great difficulty. This slowed the ship down, for if she went too fast, the makeshift rudder might be torn away as well. After crossing the Equator, the captain stopped at a port to have a new rudder fitted, but by then the Thermopylae was over five hundred miles ahead. The Cutty Sark reached England only a week later, remarkable considering her many delays. There is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder, she would have won the race easily.

stage5.stem: "Sailing vessels were used to ___ tea from China."(be used to do sth = 被用来做)
stage5.stem_cn: 帆船曾被用来从中国运茶。

stage5.stem: "Long ago, sailors ___ sing while they worked."(表“过去常常做某事”)
stage5.stem_cn: 很久以前,水手们干活时常常唱歌。

stage5.stem: "An old sailor is used to ___ in rough seas."(be used to doing = 习惯于做)
stage5.stem_cn: 老水手习惯了在风浪中航行。

stage5.stem: "During the race she had a great ___ of bad luck."(修饰不可数名词 luck)
stage5.stem_cn: 比赛中她遇到很多倒霉事。

stage5.stem: "A great ___ ships were replaced by steamships."(修饰可数名词 ships)
stage5.stem_cn: 许许多多帆船被蒸汽船取代了。

stage5.stem: "The Cutty Sark carried a lot ___ tea and wool."(a lot ___ + 名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 卡蒂萨克号运载了大量茶叶和羊毛。

stage5.stem: "During the storm the ship was almost ___ fire from a lightning strike."(“着火”固定搭配)
stage5.stem_cn: 暴风雨中,闪电差点让船着起火来。

stage5.stem: "The sailors reached the port ___ foot to find help."(“步行”固定搭配)
stage5.stem_cn: 水手们步行到港口去求援。

stage5.stem: "The captain was ___ a hurry to fix the rudder."(“匆忙”固定搭配)
"The captain stopped at a port to have a new rudder ___."(have sth done,用过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 船长在一个港口停下,请人装了新舵。

stage5.stem: "They had the broken mast ___ before setting off again."(have sth done)
stage5.stem_cn: 再次起航前,他们把断了的桅杆修好了。

stage5.stem: "You should have your compass ___ before a long voyage."(have sth done)
stage5.stem_cn: 长途航行前你该请人检查一下罗盘。

stage5.stem: "The race was the last of ___ kind."(表“它的”,所属)
stage5.stem_cn: 这场比赛是同类中的最后一场。

stage5.stem: "If the ship went ___ fast, the rudder might break."(“太…以致不好”用哪个)
stage5.stem_cn: 船要是开得太快,舵可能会断。

stage5.stem: "The Thermopylae managed to ___ the Cutty Sark by a week."(“击败对手”用哪个)
stage5.stem_cn: 塞莫皮莱号以一周之差赢了卡蒂萨克号。

stage5.stem: "The flat blade at the back of a ship used to steer it is the ___."(“舵”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 船尾用来控制方向的扁板。

stage5.stem: "A large boat or ship is also called a ___."(“船,大木船”用哪个词)
"Something meant to last only a short time is ___."(“临时的”用哪个词)
